result.instructions: Tools for SpyFu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who are the top SEO competitors of example.com, and which keywords do we share?"; "Show the most valuable organic keywords of competitor.com in the UK."; "What are the search volume and cost per click of these 10 keywords?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SpyFu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spyfu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spyfu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spyfu_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spyfu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats
tools.title: Get latest domain stats
tools.description: Latest SEO and PPC stats of a domain: monthly organic clicks, paid clicks, budget, ranking keywords, strength. Use past_n_months for more months. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getLatestDomainStats.

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.

past_n_months.description: Number of past months to return (rows are billed).

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats_history
tools.title: Get full domain stats history
tools.description: Monthly SEO and PPC stats of a domain for all months SpyFu has (many rows, billed per row). Prefer spyfu_get_domain_stats unless you need the full history. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getAllDomainStats.

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats_for_month
tools.title: Get domain stats for one month
tools.description: SEO and PPC stats of a domain for one month (yyyy-mm). API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getDomainStatsForExactDate.

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.

annotations.title: Get domain stats for one month

tools.name: spyfu_get_bulk_domain_stats
tools.title: Get stats for several domains
tools.description: SEO and PPC stats for up to 20 domains in one call (comma-separated). By default only the latest month per domain. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getBulkDomainStats.

only_latest.description: Only the latest month per domain (default true).

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.

tools.name: spyfu_find_matching_domains
tools.title: Find domains matching a keyword
tools.description: Find domains that match a search phrase, with traffic, budget and strength figures. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getMatchingDomains.

page_size.description: Rows to return (default 5, max 100). Each row is billed by SpyFu.

starting_row.description: First row to return, 1-based (default 1). Use it to page.

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.

page_size.description: Rows to return (default 5, max 100). Each row is billed by SpyFu.

tools.name: spyfu_get_competing_keywords
tools.title: Get keywords shared by domains
tools.description: Keywords that several domains rank or advertise for (overlap) or that only the first domain has (is_intersection false and exclude_domains set). channel: seo or ppc. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET keyword_api/v2/kombat/getCompeting<Seo|Ppc>Keywords.

is_intersection.description: true = keywords all domains share (default); false = keywords of any domain.

page_size.description: Rows to return (default 5, max 100). Each row is billed by SpyFu.

starting_row.description: First row to return, 1-based (default 1). Use it to page.

country_code.description: Country market (Google domain version). Default US.
